Magical Beast · 3 hexes · SM +1 Lammasu [Monster Manual, page 165]

A golden lion's body with enormous bronze-gold wings and the head of a dark-haired man, amber-eyed and grave. It guards old sites and older obligations, breathes fire when pressed to it, and speaks with anyone willing to be reasonable first.
